subject: Nutrition

questions.q: A 50-year-old male with hypertension is starting the DASH diet. Which of the following nutrient profiles best describes the DASH diet?
options: High in sodium, low in potassium.
High in fruits, vegetables, and low-fat dairy; low in saturated fat and sodium.
High in protein and fat, low in carbohydrates.
Exclusively plant-based with no animal products.
questions.explain: Dietary Approaches to Stop Hypertension (DASH) emphasizes fruits, vegetables, low-fat dairy, whole grains, and limits saturated fat and sodium.
